TechnicalAnalystReport.description:
Output of the Technical Analyst agent.

Covers trend direction, momentum, volatility regime, and the quant
ensemble's raw probability output. This is the bridge between the
existing CatBoost/XGBoost/LightGBM pipeline and the agent layer.

trend_direction.description: Overall trend direction based on EMA alignment and price action.

ema_alignment.description: EMA alignment state. e.g. 'EMA9 > EMA21 > EMA50 (bullish stack)' or 'price below all EMAs (bearish)'.
ema_alignment.title: Ema Alignment

momentum_state.description: MACD momentum description. e.g. 'MACD line crossed above signal — bullish momentum building' or 'MACD histogram shrinking — momentum fading'.
momentum_state.title: Momentum State

macd_crossover.description: True if a MACD signal-line crossover occurred in the last 3 bars.
macd_crossover.title: Macd Crossover

volatility_regime.description: Current volatility regime based on ATR relative to 20-day average ATR.

bb_squeeze.description: True if Bollinger Bands are in a squeeze (bandwidth below 20-day average), indicating a potential breakout setup.
bb_squeeze.title: Bb Squeeze

bb_position.description: Price position within Bollinger Bands. e.g. 'price at upper band (87th percentile)' or 'price near middle band'.
bb_position.title: Bb Position

quant_prob_up.description: Ensemble meta-learner probability of price going UP (CatBoost/XGB/LGB mean).
quant_prob_up.title: Quant Prob Up

quant_consensus.description: True if at least 2/3 base models agree on direction (consensus gate passed).
quant_consensus.title: Quant Consensus

confidence_score.description: Technical analyst's composite confidence score (0–1). Derived from: signal strength + momentum alignment + volatility regime + RSI state.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

signal_conflicts.description: List of detected conflicts between indicators. e.g. ['Quant says LONG but RSI is overbought (77)', 'BB squeeze active — breakout direction uncertain'].
signal_conflicts.title: Signal Conflicts

summary.description: Concise ~150-word structured narrative covering trend, momentum, volatility regime, and quant signal alignment. No free-form speculation.
summary.title: Summary

TechnicalAnalystReport.title: TechnicalAnalystReport

DigestionWindow.description:
Where we are in the ~5-trading-day shock digestion window (Chai et al. 2021).
Markets typically absorb oil/VIX/DXY shocks within 5 days.
EARLY → shock occurred <2 days ago, still propagating
MID   → 2-3 days post-shock, partial digestion
LATE  → 4-5 days post-shock, nearly absorbed
NONE  → no significant recent shock detected
DigestionWindow.title: DigestionWindow

GoldDriver.description:
Dominant macro driver per Chai et al. 2021 SVAR analysis.
OIL  → crude oil returns explain ~89% of gold forecast error variance
VIX  → rising VIX is bullish for gold (4%→7.5% of variance over 10 periods)
DXY  → negative but weak relationship (~0.5% of variance) — do NOT overweight
MIXED → multiple drivers active simultaneously
GoldDriver.title: GoldDriver

SignalStrength.description: Conviction level for a directional call.
SignalStrength.title: SignalStrength

MacroAnalystReport.description:
Output of the Macro/Fundamental Analyst agent.

CRITICAL: This agent's reasoning is GROUNDED in the quantified relationships
from Chai et al. 2021's SVAR analysis on gold price drivers:

  1. Crude oil returns explain ~89% of gold's forecast error variance
     → Oil price shocks are the DOMINANT driver. Weight heavily.

  2. VIX has a positive, growing relationship with gold returns
     (rises from ~4% to ~7.5% of variance over 10 periods)
     → Rising VIX = bullish for gold.

  3. DXY (USD index) has a NEGATIVE but WEAK relationship (~0.5% of variance)
     → Do NOT let this agent overweight dollar moves.

  4. All shocks are digested within ~5 trading days
     → Always flag early/mid/late digestion window for any recent shock.

macro_bias.description: Overall macro directional bias for gold based on current driver state.

bias_strength.description: Conviction behind the macro bias — reflects clarity of dominant driver signal.

dominant_driver.description: Dominant macro driver currently active per Chai et al. 2021 variance decomposition. OIL = crude oil shock (89% variance weight). VIX = fear spike (4-7.5%). DXY = dollar move (0.5% — low weight). MIXED = multiple active.

oil_return_5d.description: Crude oil 5-day return (%). Positive = oil up = bullish gold signal.
oil_return_5d.title: Oil Return 5D

oil_shock_active.description: True if crude oil moved >3% in the last 5 trading days, triggering the dominant SVAR channel.
oil_shock_active.title: Oil Shock Active

oil_shock_direction.description: Direction of the oil shock if active, else NEUTRAL.

vix_direction.description: VIX trend direction over the past 5 days. BULLISH = VIX rising (bullish for gold). BEARISH = VIX falling.

dxy_direction.description: DXY trend. BEARISH = dollar weakening (mildly bullish for gold). Note: DXY explains only ~0.5% of gold variance — do not overweight.

dxy_impact_weight.default: LOW (~0.5% variance per Chai et al. 2021)
dxy_impact_weight.description: Explicit reminder of DXY's limited explanatory power for this agent.
dxy_impact_weight.title: Dxy Impact Weight

digestion_window_status.description: Position in the ~5-day shock digestion window (Chai et al. 2021). EARLY (<2d since shock): still propagating. MID (2-3d): partial. LATE (4-5d): nearly absorbed. NONE: no recent significant shock.

days_since_last_shock.description: Number of trading days since the last significant macro shock (if any).
days_since_last_shock.title: Days Since Last Shock

chai_2021_narrative.description: Explicit reference to which Chai et al. 2021 relationship is currently dominant and how it maps to the current macro state. Must name the specific SVAR finding.
chai_2021_narrative.title: Chai 2021 Narrative

summary.description: ~150-word structured macro summary with explicit reference to which Chai et al. 2021 driver relationship is dominant. No generic macro commentary.
summary.title: Summary

MacroAnalystReport.title: MacroAnalystReport

SignalStrength.description: Conviction level for a directional call.
SignalStrength.title: SignalStrength

SentimentAnalystReport.description:
Output of the News/Sentiment Analyst agent.

Synthesises FinBERT historical scores, live VADER scores, and
GDELT event categories into a structured sentiment state.

sentiment_direction.description: Overall sentiment direction for gold based on news flow.

sentiment_intensity.description: Intensity of the sentiment signal. STRONG = scores far from neutral. WEAK = scores near zero. MODERATE = between.

finbert_score.description: FinBERT mean sentiment score from historical news_sentiment_cache.csv (positive = bullish gold, negative = bearish gold).
finbert_score.title: Finbert Score

vader_score.description: Live VADER compound score (gold-context lexicon enhanced). Range -1 to +1.
vader_score.title: Vader Score

blended_score.description: Blended sentiment: 70% FinBERT (historical) + 30% VADER (live). Matches the blend used in step11_api_server.py.
blended_score.title: Blended Score

active_gdelt_categories.description: List of GDELT event categories detected in the past 4 hours. e.g. ['WAR_GEOPOLITICAL', 'FED_POLICY']. Categories: WAR_MILITARY, FED_POLICY, INFLATION, DOLLAR_FX, CRISIS, ENERGY, GOLD_MARKET.
active_gdelt_categories.title: Active Gdelt Categories

high_impact_event_active.description: True if WAR_MILITARY or FED_POLICY category is currently active in GDELT — these are the two highest-impact categories for gold per historical analysis.
high_impact_event_active.title: High Impact Event Active

war_geopolitical_active.description: True if WAR_MILITARY GDELT category is active — triggers PANIC regime.
war_geopolitical_active.title: War Geopolitical Active

headline_sample.description: Up to 5 most relevant recent headlines (source of the sentiment reading).
headline_sample.title: Headline Sample

news_volume_24h.description: Number of gold-relevant news articles processed in the last 24 hours.
news_volume_24h.title: News Volume 24H

summary.description: ~150-word structured summary: sentiment direction, intensity, active GDELT categories, and whether any high-impact event category is live.
summary.title: Summary

SentimentAnalystReport.title: SentimentAnalystReport

VolatilityFlag.description: Calendar event proximity flag for the Calendar Analyst.
VolatilityFlag.title: VolatilityFlag

CalendarAnalystReport.description:
Output of the Event/Calendar Analyst agent.

Flags proximity to scheduled high-volatility macro events.
This report directly influences the Risk Management team's caution level
— a high caution_level shifts weight toward the Safe/Conservative agent.

event_window_active.description: True if a HIGH-impact event (NFP/FOMC/CPI) is within ±2 hours of now. This is the primary agent-layer activation trigger.
event_window_active.title: Event Window Active

volatility_flag.description: IMMINENT = HIGH event within 2h. APPROACHING = HIGH event within 24h. CLEAR = no HIGH event in next 24h.

events_within_2h.description: List of HIGH-impact events within ±2 hours. Each dict: {'event': str, 'date': str, 'impact': str, 'hours_until': float}.
events_within_2h.title: Events Within 2H

events_within_24h.description: List of all tracked events (HIGH + MEDIUM) within the next 24 hours. Each dict: {'event': str, 'date': str, 'impact': str, 'hours_until': float}.
events_within_24h.title: Events Within 24H

caution_level.description: Caution level for Risk Management team weighting. 0 = CLEAR (no upcoming events). 1 = LOW (MEDIUM event within 24h). 2 = MEDIUM (HIGH event within 24h). 3 = HIGH (HIGH event within 2h — IMMINENT). Each +1 shifts Risk team weighting toward Safe agent.
caution_level.title: Caution Level

next_high_impact_event.description: Name of the next HIGH-impact event and its ETA. e.g. 'US NFP (August) in 1.5h'.
next_high_impact_event.title: Next High Impact Event

summary.description: Structured summary of calendar state: active event window, upcoming events, and recommended caution level for Risk Manager.
summary.title: Summary

CalendarAnalystReport.title: CalendarAnalystReport

DebateRound.description: A single round of the bull/bear debate (natural language — not structured).

bull_argument.description: Bullish researcher's argument for this round. Natural language. Must cite specific fields from analyst reports, not generic commentary. May NOT claim the quant ensemble is wrong — only cite context the model cannot see.
bull_argument.title: Bull Argument

bear_argument.description: Bearish researcher's argument for this round. Natural language. Must cite specific fields from analyst reports, not generic commentary. May NOT claim the quant ensemble is wrong — only cite context the model cannot see.
bear_argument.title: Bear Argument

DebateRound.title: DebateRound

DebateSide.description: Which side won the bull/bear debate.
DebateSide.title: DebateSide

SignalStrength.description: Conviction level for a directional call.
SignalStrength.title: SignalStrength

DebateSummary.description:
Output of the Debate Facilitator agent.

Reviews the full debate transcript and produces a structured verdict.
This summary is passed to the Trader Agent — it does NOT override
the quant ensemble's core probability signal.

stronger_side.description: Which side's case was better supported by the analyst evidence.

confidence_in_verdict.description: Facilitator's confidence in the verdict. WEAK = debate was close.

bull_key_arguments.description: Top 2–4 bullish arguments that were well-evidenced by analyst reports.
bull_key_arguments.title: Bull Key Arguments

bear_key_arguments.description: Top 2–4 bearish arguments that were well-evidenced by analyst reports.
bear_key_arguments.title: Bear Key Arguments

key_unresolved_tension.description: The most important signal conflict that neither side resolved. e.g. 'Technical model says LONG but Macro Analyst notes VIX just spiked AND oil dropped sharply — these conflict with the bullish quant call.' None if no significant tension detected.
key_unresolved_tension.title: Key Unresolved Tension

quant_signal_preserved.description: True if the debate did not find compelling evidence to override the quant ensemble's direction. False if both researchers cited strong contextual evidence AGAINST the quant signal.
quant_signal_preserved.title: Quant Signal Preserved

quant_override_rationale.description: If quant_signal_preserved=False, explains what specific context (invisible to the numeric model) justifies caution about the quant signal.
quant_override_rationale.title: Quant Override Rationale

debate_transcript.description: Full debate transcript — all rounds preserved for audit trail.
debate_transcript.title: Debate Transcript

summary.description: Facilitator's structured verdict: which side won, key evidence, unresolved tensions, and whether the quant signal holds up under scrutiny.
summary.title: Summary

DebateSummary.title: DebateSummary

TraderProposal.description:
Output of the Trader Agent.

Synthesises: quant ensemble signal + debate summary + SL/TP/sizing constraints.
This is a PROPOSAL — it goes to the Risk Management team next.
The Fund Manager is the only agent whose output triggers actual decisions.

direction.description: Proposed trade direction: LONG, SHORT, or HOLD.

confidence_score.description: Trader's composite confidence score (0–1). Inputs: quant prob + debate verdict strength + analyst consensus + absence of signal conflicts.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

proposed_sl_pips.description: Proposed stop-loss distance in pips. Must respect MIN_PIPS=100 and MAX_PIPS=500 cap from step3b_position_sizing.py.
proposed_sl_pips.title: Proposed Sl Pips

proposed_tp_pips.description: Proposed take-profit distance in pips. Target R:R >= 1:2.
proposed_tp_pips.title: Proposed Tp Pips

proposed_lot_size.description: Proposed lot size based on $50 risk budget and sl_pips. Must align with step3b_position_sizing.py formula.
proposed_lot_size.title: Proposed Lot Size

quant_signal_in.description: The quant ensemble's signal that was passed into this agent.
quant_signal_in.title: Quant Signal In

quant_prob_up.description: The quant ensemble's UP probability passed into this agent.
quant_prob_up.title: Quant Prob Up

quant_signal_override.description: True if the Trader is proposing a direction DIFFERENT from the quant signal. This should be RARE and requires explicit override_rationale.
quant_signal_override.title: Quant Signal Override

override_rationale.description: If quant_signal_override=True: the specific agent-layer evidence that justifies deviating from the quant model's direction.
override_rationale.title: Override Rationale

synthesis_basis.description: Key inputs that drove this proposal. e.g. ['Quant: LONG (prob_up=0.73)', 'Macro: oil shock active, VIX rising — both bullish', 'Debate: Bull side stronger, no unresolved tensions', 'Calendar: FOMC in 6h — moderate caution applied'].
synthesis_basis.title: Synthesis Basis

rationale.description: Natural-language rationale for the proposal. Must explicitly reference the quant signal, debate verdict, and any analyst conflicts. This is the primary explainability output.
rationale.title: Rationale

TraderProposal.title: TraderProposal

RiskAgentType.description: Identity of each risk management agent.
RiskAgentType.title: RiskAgentType

RiskAssessment.description:
Output of one Risk Management agent (Risky / Safe / Neutral).

Three instances are created per decision cycle and weighted by
the current market regime (CALM/HIGH_VOL/PANIC) as configured in .env.

agent_type.description: Which risk perspective this agent represents.

regime_weight.description: This agent's weight in the final risk consensus for the current regime. Configured via REGIME_WEIGHTS_* in .env.
regime_weight.title: Regime Weight

recommendation.description: This agent's recommendation: LONG, SHORT, or HOLD.

size_adjustment_factor.description: Multiplier on the Trader's proposed lot size. 1.0 = take at full size. 0.5 = half size. 0.0 = reject (HOLD). Risky agent may suggest > 1.0 (up to 1.5x) in CALM regime.
size_adjustment_factor.title: Size Adjustment Factor

key_concerns.description: Primary risk factors this agent is flagging. e.g. ['FOMC in 3h — binary event risk', 'VIX spike suggests tail risk', 'Oil and quant signal conflict'].
key_concerns.title: Key Concerns

rationale.description: This agent's case for its recommendation and size adjustment. Natural language — this is where Risk team debate dialogue occurs.
rationale.title: Rationale

RiskAssessment.title: RiskAssessment

MarketRegime.description:
Overall market regime used to weight the Risk Management team.
CALM    → Risky agent gets more weight (configurable in .env)
HIGH_VOL → Balanced weighting
PANIC   → Safe/Conservative agent gets more weight
MarketRegime.title: MarketRegime

FundManagerDecision.description:
Final gate output. The ONLY agent whose output can trigger an order.

In AGENT_SHADOW_MODE=true (default): logged to audit trail only.
In AGENT_SHADOW_MODE=false: returned via /api/agent-decision endpoint.

Reviews: TraderProposal + all three RiskAssessment objects + regime weights.

final_decision.description: APPROVE = take the Trader's proposal as-is. REJECT = do not trade (override to HOLD). RESIZE = trade but at a different lot size than proposed.

final_direction.description: Final trade direction after Fund Manager review.

size_vs_proposal.description: How final size compares to proposal. e.g. 'APPROVED at full size', 'RESIZED to 60% of proposal', 'REJECTED'.
size_vs_proposal.title: Size Vs Proposal

risk_team_consensus.description: Summary of weighted risk team outcome. e.g. 'Risky(0.5) + Neutral(0.3) + Safe(0.2) → weighted to PROCEED at 85% size'.
risk_team_consensus.title: Risk Team Consensus

current_regime.description: Market regime at time of decision — determines risk agent weights.

quant_signal_in.description: The quant ensemble signal that entered the agent pipeline.
quant_signal_in.title: Quant Signal In

quant_prob_up.description: The quant ensemble UP probability that entered the pipeline.
quant_prob_up.title: Quant Prob Up

agent_consensus.description: High-level summary of agent consensus. e.g. 'All analysts bullish, debate bull-side stronger, risk team cautious due to FOMC'.
agent_consensus.title: Agent Consensus

full_reasoning.description: Fund Manager's complete reasoning chain: quant signal → analyst consensus → debate outcome → risk team weighting → final call. This is the primary audit-trail narrative.
full_reasoning.title: Full Reasoning

shadow_mode.description: True if this decision was produced in shadow/paper-trading mode (logged only, no real order). False = live mode.
shadow_mode.title: Shadow Mode

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of this decision.
timestamp_utc.title: Timestamp Utc

session_id.description: Unique session identifier linking all agent reports for this decision cycle.
session_id.title: Session Id

FundManagerDecision.title: FundManagerDecision

RiskAgentType.title: RiskAgentType

RiskAssessment.description:
Output of one Risk Management agent (Risky / Safe / Neutral).

Three instances are created per decision cycle and weighted by
the current market regime (CALM/HIGH_VOL/PANIC) as configured in .env.

agent_type.description: Which risk perspective this agent represents.

regime_weight.description: This agent's weight in the final risk consensus for the current regime. Configured via REGIME_WEIGHTS_* in .env.
regime_weight.title: Regime Weight

recommendation.description: This agent's recommendation: LONG, SHORT, or HOLD.

size_adjustment_factor.description: Multiplier on the Trader's proposed lot size. 1.0 = take at full size. 0.5 = half size. 0.0 = reject (HOLD). Risky agent may suggest > 1.0 (up to 1.5x) in CALM regime.
size_adjustment_factor.title: Size Adjustment Factor

key_concerns.description: Primary risk factors this agent is flagging. e.g. ['FOMC in 3h — binary event risk', 'VIX spike suggests tail risk', 'Oil and quant signal conflict'].
key_concerns.title: Key Concerns

rationale.description: This agent's case for its recommendation and size adjustment. Natural language — this is where Risk team debate dialogue occurs.
rationale.title: Rationale

RiskAssessment.title: RiskAssessment

SentimentAnalystReport.description:
Output of the News/Sentiment Analyst agent.

Synthesises FinBERT historical scores, live VADER scores, and
GDELT event categories into a structured sentiment state.

sentiment_direction.description: Overall sentiment direction for gold based on news flow.

sentiment_intensity.description: Intensity of the sentiment signal. STRONG = scores far from neutral. WEAK = scores near zero. MODERATE = between.

finbert_score.description: FinBERT mean sentiment score from historical news_sentiment_cache.csv (positive = bullish gold, negative = bearish gold).
finbert_score.title: Finbert Score

vader_score.description: Live VADER compound score (gold-context lexicon enhanced). Range -1 to +1.
vader_score.title: Vader Score

blended_score.description: Blended sentiment: 70% FinBERT (historical) + 30% VADER (live). Matches the blend used in step11_api_server.py.
blended_score.title: Blended Score

active_gdelt_categories.description: List of GDELT event categories detected in the past 4 hours. e.g. ['WAR_GEOPOLITICAL', 'FED_POLICY']. Categories: WAR_MILITARY, FED_POLICY, INFLATION, DOLLAR_FX, CRISIS, ENERGY, GOLD_MARKET.
active_gdelt_categories.title: Active Gdelt Categories

high_impact_event_active.description: True if WAR_MILITARY or FED_POLICY category is currently active in GDELT — these are the two highest-impact categories for gold per historical analysis.
high_impact_event_active.title: High Impact Event Active

war_geopolitical_active.description: True if WAR_MILITARY GDELT category is active — triggers PANIC regime.
war_geopolitical_active.title: War Geopolitical Active

headline_sample.description: Up to 5 most relevant recent headlines (source of the sentiment reading).
headline_sample.title: Headline Sample

news_volume_24h.description: Number of gold-relevant news articles processed in the last 24 hours.
news_volume_24h.title: News Volume 24H

summary.description: ~150-word structured summary: sentiment direction, intensity, active GDELT categories, and whether any high-impact event category is live.
summary.title: Summary

SentimentAnalystReport.title: SentimentAnalystReport

SignalStrength.description: Conviction level for a directional call.
SignalStrength.title: SignalStrength

TechnicalAnalystReport.description:
Output of the Technical Analyst agent.

Covers trend direction, momentum, volatility regime, and the quant
ensemble's raw probability output. This is the bridge between the
existing CatBoost/XGBoost/LightGBM pipeline and the agent layer.

trend_direction.description: Overall trend direction based on EMA alignment and price action.

ema_alignment.description: EMA alignment state. e.g. 'EMA9 > EMA21 > EMA50 (bullish stack)' or 'price below all EMAs (bearish)'.
ema_alignment.title: Ema Alignment

momentum_state.description: MACD momentum description. e.g. 'MACD line crossed above signal — bullish momentum building' or 'MACD histogram shrinking — momentum fading'.
momentum_state.title: Momentum State

macd_crossover.description: True if a MACD signal-line crossover occurred in the last 3 bars.
macd_crossover.title: Macd Crossover

volatility_regime.description: Current volatility regime based on ATR relative to 20-day average ATR.

bb_squeeze.description: True if Bollinger Bands are in a squeeze (bandwidth below 20-day average), indicating a potential breakout setup.
bb_squeeze.title: Bb Squeeze

bb_position.description: Price position within Bollinger Bands. e.g. 'price at upper band (87th percentile)' or 'price near middle band'.
bb_position.title: Bb Position

quant_prob_up.description: Ensemble meta-learner probability of price going UP (CatBoost/XGB/LGB mean).
quant_prob_up.title: Quant Prob Up

quant_consensus.description: True if at least 2/3 base models agree on direction (consensus gate passed).
quant_consensus.title: Quant Consensus

confidence_score.description: Technical analyst's composite confidence score (0–1). Derived from: signal strength + momentum alignment + volatility regime + RSI state.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

signal_conflicts.description: List of detected conflicts between indicators. e.g. ['Quant says LONG but RSI is overbought (77)', 'BB squeeze active — breakout direction uncertain'].
signal_conflicts.title: Signal Conflicts

summary.description: Concise ~150-word structured narrative covering trend, momentum, volatility regime, and quant signal alignment. No free-form speculation.
summary.title: Summary

TechnicalAnalystReport.title: TechnicalAnalystReport

TraderProposal.description:
Output of the Trader Agent.

Synthesises: quant ensemble signal + debate summary + SL/TP/sizing constraints.
This is a PROPOSAL — it goes to the Risk Management team next.
The Fund Manager is the only agent whose output triggers actual decisions.

direction.description: Proposed trade direction: LONG, SHORT, or HOLD.

confidence_score.description: Trader's composite confidence score (0–1). Inputs: quant prob + debate verdict strength + analyst consensus + absence of signal conflicts.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

proposed_sl_pips.description: Proposed stop-loss distance in pips. Must respect MIN_PIPS=100 and MAX_PIPS=500 cap from step3b_position_sizing.py.
proposed_sl_pips.title: Proposed Sl Pips

proposed_tp_pips.description: Proposed take-profit distance in pips. Target R:R >= 1:2.
proposed_tp_pips.title: Proposed Tp Pips

proposed_lot_size.description: Proposed lot size based on $50 risk budget and sl_pips. Must align with step3b_position_sizing.py formula.
proposed_lot_size.title: Proposed Lot Size

quant_signal_in.description: The quant ensemble's signal that was passed into this agent.
quant_signal_in.title: Quant Signal In

quant_prob_up.description: The quant ensemble's UP probability passed into this agent.
quant_prob_up.title: Quant Prob Up

quant_signal_override.description: True if the Trader is proposing a direction DIFFERENT from the quant signal. This should be RARE and requires explicit override_rationale.
quant_signal_override.title: Quant Signal Override

override_rationale.description: If quant_signal_override=True: the specific agent-layer evidence that justifies deviating from the quant model's direction.
override_rationale.title: Override Rationale

synthesis_basis.description: Key inputs that drove this proposal. e.g. ['Quant: LONG (prob_up=0.73)', 'Macro: oil shock active, VIX rising — both bullish', 'Debate: Bull side stronger, no unresolved tensions', 'Calendar: FOMC in 6h — moderate caution applied'].
synthesis_basis.title: Synthesis Basis

rationale.description: Natural-language rationale for the proposal. Must explicitly reference the quant signal, debate verdict, and any analyst conflicts. This is the primary explainability output.
rationale.title: Rationale

TraderProposal.title: TraderProposal

VolatilityFlag.description: Calendar event proximity flag for the Calendar Analyst.
VolatilityFlag.title: VolatilityFlag

AgentSessionLog.description:
Complete audit trail for one decision cycle.
Logged to agents_audit.db and agents_log/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM_<session_id>.jsonl.

Every agent's full report and reasoning is preserved here — this is the
explainability benefit the TradingAgents paper highlights over black-box models.

trigger_reason.description: Why the agent layer activated. e.g. 'US NFP (August) in 1.2h' or 'WAR_MILITARY GDELT event detected'.
trigger_reason.title: Trigger Reason

risk_assessments.description: All three risk agent assessments (RISKY, SAFE, NEUTRAL).
risk_assessments.title: Risk Assessments

actual_next_day_direction.description: Filled in after the fact: actual gold price direction next session. Used for shadow-mode performance comparison vs quant baseline.
actual_next_day_direction.title: Actual Next Day Direction

quant_baseline_correct.description: Whether the pure quant signal was correct for this event window.
quant_baseline_correct.title: Quant Baseline Correct

agent_decision_correct.description: Whether the Fund Manager's final decision was correct.
agent_decision_correct.title: Agent Decision Correct

api_calls.description: Per-agent LLM call metadata for cost tracking.
api_calls.title: Api Calls

total_cost_usd.description: Total estimated API cost for this decision cycle (USD).
total_cost_usd.title: Total Cost Usd

total_latency_ms.description: Wall-clock time for the full pipeline execution (ms).
total_latency_ms.title: Total Latency Ms

AgentSessionLog.title: AgentSessionLog
